## Univariate SARIMA for each month (preserving monthly patterns)

```{r}
library(forecast)
library(tsibble)
```

```{r}
backtest_sarima_monthly <- function(csv_file, district_name,
                                     train_years = 7, h = 3,
                                     seasonal = TRUE) {
  
  df <- read.csv(csv_file)
  y_mat <- as.matrix(df)
  colnames(y_mat) <- as.character(2015:(2015 + ncol(y_mat) - 1))
  
  n_total <- ncol(y_mat)
  n_train <- train_years
  n_test <- h
  
  # Split
  y_train <- y_mat[, 1:n_train]
  y_test <- y_mat[, (n_train + 1):n_total]
  
  n_months <- nrow(y_mat)  # Should be 12
  
  # Store predictions for each month
  y_pred <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_months, ncol = n_test)
  
  # Fit separate SARIMA model for each month
  for (month in 1:n_months) {
    # Extract time series for this month across training years
    monthly_ts <- ts(y_train[month, ], 
                     start = c(2015, month), 
                     frequency = 12)
    
    # Auto-select SARIMA model or use specified order
    # Using auto.arima for simplicity, but you can specify custom orders
    fit <- auto.arima(monthly_ts, 
                      seasonal = seasonal,
                      stepwise = FALSE,
                      approximation = FALSE)
    
    # Forecast h years ahead
    fc <- forecast(fit, h = n_test)
    
    # Store predictions
    y_pred[month, ] <- as.numeric(fc$mean)
  }
  # Calculate errors
  errors <- as.vector(y_test) - as.vector(y_pred)
  rmse <- sqrt(mean(errors^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  mae <- mean(abs(errors), na.rm = TRUE)
  mape <- mean(abs(errors / as.vector(y_test)) * 100, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Monthly RMSE
  monthly_rmse <- sqrt(rowMeans((y_test - y_pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  list(
    district = district_name,
    rmse = round(rmse, 4),
    mae = round(mae, 4),
    mape = round(mape, 2),
    monthly_rmse = round(monthly_rmse, 4),
    y_actual = y_test,
    y_pred = y_pred,
    model_type = "SARIMA (monthly models)"
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Run backtests
results_sarima <- list(
  backtest_sarima_monthly("Borguna.csv",    "Barguna"),
  backtest_sarima_monthly("Joypurhat.csv",  "Joypurhat"),
  backtest_sarima_monthly("Mymensingh.csv", "Mymensingh"),
  backtest_sarima_monthly("Netrokona.csv",  "Netrokona")
)
```

```{r}
# Create accuracy table
acc_table_sarima <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results_sarima, function(r) {
  data.frame(
    District = r$district,
    RMSE     = r$rmse,
    MAE      = r$mae,
    MAPE     = paste0(r$mape, "%")
  )
}))
```

```{r}
print(acc_table_sarima, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
backtest_sarima_long <- function(csv_file, district_name,
                                  train_years = 7, h = 3) {
  
  df <- read.csv(csv_file)
  y_mat <- as.matrix(df)
  
  n_total <- ncol(y_mat)
  n_train <- train_years
  n_test <- h
  n_months <- nrow(y_mat)
  
  # Convert to long format time series
  years <- 2015:(2015 + n_total - 1)
  
  # Create time series object (monthly data)
  full_ts <- ts(as.vector(y_mat), 
                start = c(2015, 1), 
                frequency = 12)
  
  # Split into train and test
  train_length <- n_train * n_months
  train_ts <- window(full_ts, end = c(2015 + train_years - 1, n_months))
  test_ts <- window(full_ts, start = c(2015 + train_years, 1))
  
  # Fit SARIMA model
  # You can specify custom orders: ARIMA(p,d,q)(P,D,Q)[12]
  # Example: fit <- Arima(train_ts, order = c(1,0,1), seasonal = c(1,0,1))
  
  # Auto-select best SARIMA model
  fit <- auto.arima(train_ts, 
                    seasonal = TRUE,
                    stepwise = FALSE,
                    approximation = FALSE,
                    trace = FALSE)  # Set trace=TRUE to see model selection
  
  # Forecast
  fc <- forecast(fit, h = n_test * n_months)
  
  # Reshape predictions to matrix (months × years)
  y_pred <- matrix(fc$mean, nrow = n_months, ncol = n_test)
  y_test <- y_mat[, (n_train + 1):n_total]
  
  # Calculate errors
  errors <- as.vector(y_test) - as.vector(y_pred)
  rmse <- sqrt(mean(errors^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  mae <- mean(abs(errors), na.rm = TRUE)
  mape <- mean(abs(errors / as.vector(y_test)) * 100, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Monthly RMSE
  monthly_rmse <- sqrt(rowMeans((y_test - y_pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  list(
    district = district_name,
    rmse = round(rmse, 4),
    mae = round(mae, 4),
    mape = round(mape, 2),
    monthly_rmse = round(monthly_rmse, 4),
    y_actual = y_test,
    y_pred = y_pred,
    model = fit,
    model_type = "SARIMA (long format)"
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Run backtests
results_sarima_long <- list(
  backtest_sarima_long("Borguna.csv",    "Barguna"),
  backtest_sarima_long("Joypurhat.csv",  "Joypurhat"),
  backtest_sarima_long("Mymensingh.csv", "Mymensingh"),
  backtest_sarima_long("Netrokona.csv",  "Netrokona")
)
```

```{r}
# Create accuracy table
acc_table_sarima_long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results_sarima_long, function(r) {
  data.frame(
    District = r$district,
    RMSE     = r$rmse,
    MAE      = r$mae,
    MAPE     = paste0(r$mape, "%")
  )
}))
```

```{r}
print(acc_table_sarima_long, row.names = FALSE)
```
